title: Decision
description: Single architectural or design decision attached to a phase or run. One decision per file. Filename = <phase-id-or-run-id>-<slug>.yaml.

phase.description: Phase identifier the decision attaches to (e.g. p0161). Must match the filename prefix.

run.description: Run identifier the decision attaches to (e.g. r07). Must match the filename prefix.

chose.description: One-line summary of what was picked.

over.description: One-line summary of the obvious alternative that was rejected.

reason.description: Multi-line explanation of WHY. Free-form. Use [[other-decision-slug]] to link related decisions.

alternatives.description: Other alternatives considered, each a one-line summary including why rejected.
